name: The Other Sister (Bercinta Dengan Maut)
overview: When Anna, the wife of the heir of an influential political family, mysteriously died, her twin brother who was separated, Raya—a nightclub dancer—retributing her identity to unravel the dark secrets of the Ardana family. Yet amid intrigue, treason, and murder, Raya is caught between the ambition of revenge and forbidden love that threatens to destroy everything.
